title: Petal Pixie's static '+1 Might for each of your units with [Temporary] at my battlefield' is applied as a flat, unconditional +1 Might instead of counting Temporary units at its battlefield.
expected: Card file /root/src/tcg/tcg-engines/packages/riftbound-cards/src/cards/unl/petal-pixie.ts:4-15 has no `abilities`, so enrich-cards.ts:30 parses rulesText. Running the parser yields {type:'static', effect:{type:'modify-might', amount:1, per:'of your units with [Temporary] at my battlefield', target:'self'}} — static-parser.ts:36-60 parseForEachQualifier only recognizes 'other unit here with my name' and 'token unit you control', so it falls through to the `per` string branch at static-parser.ts:717-729. In the engine, static-abilities.ts:628-632 applyStaticEffect treats numeric `amount` as a constant (amount = rawAmount) and there is no handling of `effect.per` anywhere in static-abilities.ts, so staticMightBonus is always +1 regardless of Temporary unit count.
observed: meta.staticMightBonus is always 1 and UI 'Effective Might' shows 3 in every case: alone in base with zero Temporary units anywhere (should be 2), with 1 Temporary unit at its battlefield (3, coincidentally correct), and with 2 Temporary units (Keeper of Masks + Sprite token w/ keywords:['Temporary']) at its battlefield (should be 4). Root cause: card file has no abilities; text parser emits {type:'static', effect:{type:'modify-might', amount:1, per:'of your units with [Temporary] at my battlefield', target:'self'}} — the 'per' clause is left as an unparsed string and static-abilities.ts treats numeric amount:1 as a constant.
